data.body: Fast-path Phase 1 RCA (confirmed before repair): relation-scoped unlink shipped in commit 73abb5805f and deliberately changed the real CLI/library contract while preserving the omitted-selector most-recent fallback. That commit updated src/rebar/_cli/help/unlink.txt, docs/cli-reference.md, and docs/user-guide.md, but its diff did not touch src/rebar/_cli/help/overview.txt or docs/ticket-model.md; both retain their pre-change wording from earlier commits. Runtime proof: the current `rebar unlink --help` advertises `[relation]`, while `rebar --help` (which loads packaged overview data through rebar._cli._help) still emits `no relation arg`. Existing authoritative behavioral coverage in tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_unlink_relation_scoped_e39f.py proves explicit relation removal preserves the pair's other active relation and omission retains pair-scoped fallback. The same stale statement also remains in docs/event-schema.md and will be handled as an in-scope documentation sibling. Root cause: the e39f edit set enumerated only the subcommand help plus two generated/user docs and omitted the independently maintained overview and model/schema prose, so their published contract never advanced. Legitimacy: defect, grounded in the operator-ratified e39f commit contract, current CLI/library signatures, and passing relation-scoped behavioral tests. Fast-path gates hold: deterministic live help contradiction, one omission mechanism, docs-only reversible blast radius.
